chat.answer:
**₹1,234,567**

The figure in the text is written in the Indian (lakh) grouping system as **₹12,34,567** — that is 12 lakh, 34 thousand, 567.

Conversion applied: regroup the same seven digits from `…,34,567` (thousands, then a lakh block of two digits) into three-digit groups counted from the right.

- 12 × 1,00,000 = 1,200,000
- 34 × 1,000 = 34,000
- 567 = 567
- Total = 1,234,567 ✓ same value, digits unchanged

So the revenue figure restated in the international grouping system is **₹1,234,567** (= ₹12,34,567, i.e. ₹12.34567 lakh).
